rule: Each mandal against its own median for that calendar month, over the months it has. Positive is deeper than usual.
scaleRule: Each mandal's own half-range (10th to 90th percentile of its anomalies), floored at 0.5 m, so the colour reads as unusual for that mandal.

pacific.rule: Share of mandals deeper than their own usual, against Nino 3.4 in the same month and at lags after it.
pacific.caveat: A description of these twelve years, not a forecast. Both series move slowly, so far fewer than the month count are independent and no significance is claimed; the lag is where the correlation peaks.

marks.label: Driest month
marks.why: 89.5% of mandals deeper than their own usual
